# S60-R

Synthetic signed v4 integration record; no real account or claimed authentication. The in-memory non-extractable P-256 private key was discarded when construction ended. Only the public key, signed payload and signature are retained.

Returns are exactly S60's stored integers. Dates are consecutive calendar days, 2025-01-01 through 2025-03-02, deliberately including weekends despite q=252.

The existing verifier accepted schema, signatures, chain and arithmetic. effectiveStamps(profile) yields exactly one slot. Its schedule is incompatible_spacing; SPEC-03 §6.3 maps this to schedule_compatible=false. The input and oracle expectation concern only that derived unsigned statistics view.
